entities.name: Shaqe Çoba
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shaqe Çoba, née Shiroka, (1875–1954) was an Albanian feminist and suffragist. She founded The Albanian Woman, an organization for upper-class women which briefly published a magazine of the same name that covered women's issues.
